AI Code Slop Monitor

Synthetic Code Detection Report — powered by SynthScan

Suggest a Repository to be Scanned

This report analyses 1635 GitHub repositories for AI-generated (synthetic) code patterns. The scanner uses 120+ detection patterns across 14 categories to identify code that was likely produced by large language models (LLMs). Each match carries a severity weight (Critical = 10, High = 5, Medium = 2, Low = 1) and the headline Synthetic Code Score is normalised per 1,000 lines of code so projects of different sizes can be compared fairly.

Score ranges: 0 – 5 Likely human-written   5 – 15 Low AI signal   15 – 30 Moderate AI signal   30+ Strong AI signal
